title: 智斗金角银角
subtitle: 五件宝物的智慧闯关
origin: 《西游记》第三十二至三十五回（低龄改编）

moral.zh: 遇到看似厉害的工具，先观察规则、认真倾听，再和伙伴分工合作；智慧常常比蛮力更有用。
moral.en: When a tool seems powerful, first observe its rules and listen carefully. Teamwork and clear thinking often work better than force.

pages.zh: 师徒走进平顶山，路边立着五座没有字的彩色拱门。山上传来笑声：“欢迎参加宝物智慧赛！”
pages.en: The travelers entered Flat-Top Mountain and found five colorful arches with no writing. Cheerful voices called from above, welcoming them to a treasure puzzle contest.
pages.prompt: Use the provided complete-team series anchor to establish all five travelers at the foot of Flat-Top Mountain before five colorful blank puzzle arches, while two tiny friendly golden and silver silhouettes wave from a high pavilion. pages.en: Golden Horn and Silver Horn came out to welcome them. With a purple-gold gourd, an ivory jar, and a golden rope, the brothers announced that anyone who discovered the rules could pass.

pages.en: In the first challenge, the gourd repeated the last name it heard. Instead of answering at once, Wukong clapped and listened, discovering that it remembered only the final two syllables.

pages.en: In the third challenge, the golden rope tied itself into many knots. Sha Wujing did not tug; he found the loosest loop, and everyone untied the knots in order.

pages.en: Golden Horn and Silver Horn gladly handed the travelers the true westward route. They realized that everyone's strengths working together were the greatest treasure of all.

pages.en: Taishang Laojun arrived on a cloud to put away the puzzle props and praised everyone. Just then, a jade token bearing a white crane arrived with news that Wuji Kingdom had two identical kings.
